claim: Retinal glasses or contacts are routinely used.
originalWording: Retinal glasses or contacts are routinely used.

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: Computers and communications in 2019: direct-eye displays

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Retinal glasses/contacts with the specified exceptional resolution are routinely worn, not just demonstrated.
reference.rationale: Near-eye displays existed in 2019, but mainstream routine use at the asserted acuity did not. Practical headsets/AR prove part of the direction, not routine retinal contacts or acuity above human vision.
